contracts.state: model.ts: initial empty locale/locales/loading/waitingTranslations; seedFromSettings, named transitions, no reducer
contracts.translation: translate.ts: TranslationSources carries fallbackLocale separately, app then bundled current language then fallback language; fallbackKey tried inside each language
contracts.settings: controller.ts: immutable settings read, follows locales and locale updates; loaders built before plugin registration
contracts.direction: Locale.direction, default ltr; no old rtl boolean
contracts.loaders: sync/loaders.ts: watch loading identity dedups same code; late other-code pack registers without switching; synchronous throws report/start failure, rejected loads emit exact PluginErrorInfo
contracts.disposal: after teardown watch removed and closed state rejects writes; no fake late completion of captured waiter
contracts.boundary: explicit current inputs are the authority, no copied translation/plural rules; scripted JSON loader decoding is private transport only
